normalization_notes: All operation prices normalized to per-1,000 operations. Native units: AWS per-1k, Azure per-10k, GCS per-1k, R2 per-million, B2 n/a (free).
Storage prices are per unit-month, first volume tier. GCS officially prices per GiB (binary); AWS and Azure label prices per GB. Treated as directly comparable for estimates.
Prices are pay-as-you-go list prices, single region, locally-redundant tier (LRS or equivalent), excluding VAT/taxes and committed-use or reserved discounts.
regions.us / regions.uk / regions.eu name each provider's compared regions. R2, B2 and Wasabi publish one global price list, so their regional values are identical by definition.
EU regions compared: AWS eu-west-1 (Ireland), Azure West Europe (Netherlands), GCS europe-west1 (Belgium) - each cloud's mainstream low-cost EU region.

class_bands.archive: rarely accessed; may be offline (hours to restore)

providers.name: AWS S3
providers.verified_via: AWS Price List API (pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com), offer files published 2026-09-11..28

multi_zone.note: S3 Standard, IA and Glacier classes store data across >=3 availability zones by default (One Zone classes excepted).

classes.label: S3 Standard
notes: First 50 TB tier; next 450 TB $0.022 (us/eu) / $0.023 (uk), over 500 TB $0.021 (us/eu) / $0.022 (uk).

classes.label: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval
notes: Online class: millisecond access, no restore step.

classes.label: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval
notes: Offline: standard restore takes 3-5 hours and also bills restore requests at $0.05 (us) / $0.053 (uk) / $0.055 (eu) per 1k.
Bulk restore (5-12h) is free per GB; expedited (~1-5 min) $0.03/GB + $0.01 per request.
~40 KB per-object metadata overhead billed (32 KB class rate + 8 KB Standard rate) - unverified this round.

classes.label: S3 Glacier Deep Archive
notes: Offline: standard restore ~12h, plus restore requests $0.10 (us) / $0.106 (uk) / $0.11 (eu) per 1k; bulk restore $0.0025 (us) / $0.005 (uk) / $0.003 (eu) per GB.

free.note: Global allowance aggregated across all AWS services and regions.

providers.free_tier: No always-free S3 quota on current plans; new accounts get up to $200 in credits over 6 months. 100 GB/month free egress (global).

providers.name: Azure Blob Storage
providers.verified_via: Azure Retail Prices API + the pricing page's own JSON feed (two official sources, exact agreement). Block Blob, GPv2, flat namespace, LRS.

multi_zone.note: Zone-redundant mode uses the ZRS prices below; the Archive tier does not support ZRS.

classes.label: Hot
notes: First 50 TB tier; Hot has volume tiers (next 450 TB $0.019968 us / $0.018432 uk / $0.018816 eu). Cool/Cold/Archive are flat.

classes.label: Archive
notes: Offline: standard rehydration up to 15 hours. High-priority rehydration $0.10 (us) / $0.125 (uk) / $0.13 (eu) per GB with reads at $5.00 / $6.25 / $6.50 per 1k.
Early deletion from Cool/Cold/Archive is prorated at the tier's storage rate for remaining days.
Reported (unverified): 128 KiB minimum object size for Cool/Cold/Archive from Jul 2026 (new accounts) / Jul 2027 (all).

tiers.note: Default (Microsoft Global Network) routing; $0.08 with the Internet-routing option. Steps down at ~10/50/150/500 TB.

providers.free_tier: 12 months: 5 GB Hot LRS + 20k reads + 10k writes/month (new accounts). Always free: first 100 GB/month egress.

gbp_reference.note: Azure bills UK customers in GBP. UK South storage per GB-month: Hot £0.0145, Cool £0.0079, Cold £0.0034, Archive £0.0014.

providers.name: Google Cloud Storage
providers.verified_via: Official pricing page embedded data (fetched 2026-10-10); us-east1 corroborated by 3 secondary sources.

multi_zone.note: Regional buckets store data redundantly across multiple zones within the region (synchronous).

classes.label: Archive
notes: Online class: millisecond access despite the name, but 365-day minimum and the highest retrieval fee of any provider.

providers.ops_note: Operation and retrieval prices are global (location-type based, not per region). Single-region rates shown; dual/multi-region Class A costs double; hierarchical-namespace buckets +30%.

free.note: Always Free 100 GB/month applies to North America sources only (China & Australia destinations excluded); UK and EU buckets get no free egress.

egress.tier_note: Per GiB, destination-based (source region irrelevant). Worldwide rates shown; China ($0.20-0.23) and Australia ($0.15-0.19) cost more. Tier boundaries are TiB.

providers.free_tier: 5 GB-months Standard + 5k Class A + 50k Class B ops/month, only in us-west1/us-central1/us-east1. 100 GB/month free egress from North America.

providers.name: Cloudflare R2

multi_zone.note: Cloudflare does not publish an availability-zone redundancy model for R2.

residency_notes.uk: Data is placed by Cloudflare location hint (Western Europe) - UK residency is not guaranteed. R2's only hard residency guarantee is its EU jurisdiction, which excludes the UK.
residency_notes.eu: The EU jurisdiction setting is a hard guarantee that data stays in the EU - R2's only firm residency commitment.

classes.label: R2 Infrequent Access
notes: 30-day minimum billed even if deleted/moved early. Free tier does not apply to this class.

free.note: Egress to internet is $0 via Workers, S3 API, or r2.dev.

providers.free_tier: Monthly, Standard class only: 10 GB-months storage, 1M Class A ops, 10M Class B ops. Delete operations are free.
providers.region_note: Location hints and jurisdictions (EU, FedRAMP) affect data placement only; no price difference.

providers.name: Backblaze B2
providers.verified_via: Official pricing + transaction-pricing pages (fetched 2026-10-10). Reflects the May 2026 pricing change.

regions.uk: EU region (single price list; no UK region, nearest is EU Central)

multi_zone.note: Backblaze does not publish a multi-datacentre redundancy guarantee within a B2 region.

residency_notes.uk: no UK datacentre - nearest region is Amsterdam (EU Central)

classes.label: B2 (single class)
notes: $6.95/TB/month pay-as-you-go ('starts at' - volume/term commitments discount further). Raised from $6/TB effective 2026-05-01.
All Class A/B/C API calls free since 2026-05-01. Only Class D (outbound calls, e.g. event notifications) bills: $0.004/10k after 2,500 free/day.
No minimum storage duration, no minimum file size, no early-deletion fees.

free.note: Free up to 3x average monthly data stored; unlimited free via partner CDNs (Cloudflare, Fastly, bunny.net, ...).

providers.region_note: US and EU regions share one price list (single published prices; 2019 official statement of parity).

providers.name: Wasabi
providers.verified_via: Official pricing page + pricing FAQ + docs.wasabi.com (fetched 2026-10-10). Reflects the July 2026 price change.

multi_zone.note: Wasabi does not publish a multi-availability-zone redundancy guarantee within a region.

classes.label: Hot Cloud Storage (single class)
notes: $7.99/TB/month pay-as-you-go, uniform across all regions (raised from $6.99 effective 2026-07-01; many third-party sites still show the old price). Published per-GB figure $0.0078 uses base-2 arithmetic.
90-day minimum storage duration on every object: deleting early bills the remaining days as 'Timed Deleted Storage'. A 30-day option exists for some accounts; eligibility criteria unpublished.
API requests are free under a fair-use policy (no numeric limit published).
A separate 'Wasabi Fire' NVMe performance class (~$19.99/TB) launched 2026 - out of scope here.

monthly_minimum.note: Pay-as-you-go bills a minimum of 1 TB active storage (~$7.99/month) even if you store less.

free.note: No egress charges and no overage billing. Fair-use guideline: monthly egress should not exceed active storage; sustained excess risks service limitation/suspension rather than fees.

providers.free_tier: Trial only: 100 GB for 30 days (business email) or 10 GB for 14 days (freemail); no credit card.
providers.region_note: Single published price list across NA/EMEA/APAC. Two UK regions: eu-west-1 (London/Slough) and eu-west-3 (Chessington).
